A1.justification: Both PDFs describe CleanDIFT: Diffusion Features without Noise. The complete main text and Appendices A-H are available in both, and their equations, tables, and figures support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original CleanDIFT experiments on semantic correspondence, depth estimation, segmentation, and classification, together with ablations and supplementary backbone evaluations.

after.justification: v3 reports original CleanDIFT benchmark measurements, ablations, and supplementary evaluations, including results in Tables 1-4 and 6-7 and Figures 9, 10, and 15.

M1.justification: The clean-image student, frozen noisy teacher, timestep-conditioned projection heads, alignment loss, and inference procedure are unchanged. Text-conditioning distillation and the appendix's LoRA adaptations were already present in v2.

E1.justification: Both retain COYO-700M fine-tuning, SPair-71k correspondence, NYUv2 depth, PASCAL VOC segmentation, and ImageNet1k classification. The supervised correspondence setting and alternative training-dataset comparisons in the appendices are also unchanged.

E2.justification: Corresponding experiments retain the same comparators, including DIFT, A Tale of Two Features, Telling Left from Right, DINOv2+NN, and the self-supervised depth baselines. The supervised comparison with Luo et al. [35] is also unchanged.

E3.justification: Training budgets, backbones, feature locations, data preprocessing, PCK aggregation, linear-probe procedures, and k=10 classification remain unchanged. Appendix H retains the same conditioning, resizing, and sliding-window evaluation discussion.

E4.justification: The same loss and projection-head ablations, timestep sweeps, text-conditioning study, depth-probe analysis, dataset sensitivity checks, and qualitative/PCA examples appear in both versions. No analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Both retain point-estimate reporting without evaluation-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or formal significance tests. The noise-ensembling descriptions and feature-variance analysis are unchanged.

E6.justification: Numerical entries, plotted trends, and qualitative findings are retained. Table 1 still gives 61.43 PCKbbox for DIFT with CleanDIFT features versus 59.57 for DIFT; Table 2 retains 0.444 versus 0.469 RMSE. Appendix results, including Table 7's backbone gains, also match.

T1.justification: Section 3 retains the same diffusion definitions, variance-decomposition reasoning, alignment objective in Eq. 1, and stratified timestep sampling. Mathematical glyph and typesetting differences do not change their meaning.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about noise-free, timestep-independent features, lightweight fine-tuning, downstream performance, and efficient extraction. The claimed contribution scope is unchanged.

C2.justification: Explanations concerning noise contamination, task-dependent timesteps, and textureless-edge matching remain unchanged. Both retain the same qualifications about caption dependence, dataset mismatch, and the supervised accuracy-versus-speed tradeoff.

D1.justification: Implementation disclosures and project/data links are unchanged, including 400 training steps on one A100, Adam with batch size 8 and learning rate 2e-6, projection-head construction, dataset filtering, and Appendix F's rank-64 LoRA settings.

R1.justification: The same 68 references and related-work discussion are retained. Positioning relative to diffusion-feature extraction, feature fusion, representation learning, and distillation is unchanged.

P1.justification: The acknowledgment changes the funding body's name from Ministry for Economic Affairs and Climate Action to Ministry for Economic Affairs and Energy, and the arXiv version/date stamp changes. Scientific prose and section/appendix organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 1 has revised label typography and loses a stray semicolon before its caption. Minor typesetting adjustments include changed missing-value dashes in Table 5. All 16 figures and seven tables retain their substantive content and overall arrangement.

improvement.justification: v3 updates the funding acknowledgment and makes small presentation cleanups, particularly around Figure 1. The scientific argument, experimental evidence, interpretations, and reproducibility information remain unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. These limited editorial adjustments do not materially alter overall paper quality.
